glosses: trace (rest of something that indicates its former presence; (by extension) any small amount)
trail, track, spoor (path of signs leading somewhere, also e.g. through scent)
lead, clue (evidence pointing to a solution)

examples.text: Du bist auf einer heißen Spur.
Du warst total neben der Spur.
examples.en: You were totally out of line.

examples.text: Das Schiff verschwand ohne eine Spur.
examples.en: The ship disappeared without a trace.

examples.text: Die Polizei hat noch keine Spur des Verdächtigen.
examples.en: The police have found no trace of the suspect yet.
There are fresh tracks in the snow.
